screen.reason: The paper introduces and benchmarks a novel multi-agent system (ClinicalAgents) using MCTS and dual memory for clinical reasoning. Developing and evaluating a new model architecture on benchmark datasets without testing specific organizational deployment practices or safeguards does not meet tests_practice.
